integrity: The finite lower bound and witness were recomputed from the packaged verifier using exact integer and rational arithmetic; literature originality is limited to the sources explicitly checked.
scientific_limitations: The six-player separation is tie-versus-strict rather than a strict reversal.
The result does not classify all six-player counterexamples.
Full text of one highly relevant 2012 article was not inspectable without interactive publisher verification.
title: Six voters are the sharp threshold for Banzhaf–Shapley–Shubik ordinal divergence
